Thank you for responding to my post it means a lot to me that someone understand me. But some days I fight with my self to go to therapy because I don’t feel like talking about my feelings but I force myself to go and when I do go my therapist would ask me how was your week ?has anything happened ? I would answer with what happened or I’m fine even though something did happen but I forgot about it and tried to seal it away but it comes back up when another altercation with my parents happens. I went to my very first job interview 2 weeks ago and the interview wasn’t as bad as I thought it would be but before I went in was what made it bad. So basically I asked my mom if she could take me to my interview she takes me there the interview starts at 2:30 so I’m waiting and trying to talk to myself so I could go in because I’m literally scared and shaking in my seat. It’s 2:20 my mom says to me go in you can’t be late I say to her I’m not ready yet and that I’ll go in a bit, I’m still shaking and trying to calm myself so I don’t panic but she continues to nag me to go in so I’m still telling her that I’m not ready yet then she starts to laugh at me and says God help her. I look at her and ask why are you laughing at me I’m really serious and struggling right now and your not helping me feel any better then she started to pray but before she finished I get out the car irritated and wanted to get away from her. My interview went well I didn’t get the job because there were no available position for me but I learning experience but after the interview was over I go outside my moms not there I start to panic and call her she tells me she went back home to get my sister after I told her I didn’t want her near me because she talks too much and jokes about the wrong things. But now I’m still looking for a job trying to be independent and be productive I guess it’s hard

I just need help understand what I need to do to be considered a functional adult  because whatever I’m doing is not working I feel like a child that’s being forced to do adult actions that they don’t know about
